svg.title: GitlabHarvester use cases and their flags
svg.desc: A tree: the gitlab-harvester command branches into use cases (search terms, only some files, keep the files, every file by name, only some projects, project inventory, branches and forks, fresh findings, speed and rate limits, several tokens, reports and history, config file), each with its main command-line flags. Shortcut flags show what they expand to.
svg.text: Every branch is a scenario from docs/USE_CASES.md (the number is its section); combine flags from any of them in one run.
one term or a list, resumable
copies, all results in one ZIP
dedup, JSON, a log of every run
the same options in an INI file
shortcut: sets several options at once (a specific option wins)
